name: Liveness scoring + backlog hardening
summary: Current develop cycle: tech-debt hardening already merged (atomic feedback-store writes; Clean egress identity strings at the source), plus the planned liveness dimension (active/armed/dormant, fed into scoring so a dead persistence remnant scores below a live one) and Findings concern-coloring + revisitable decision flags. Real destination names (SNI/DNS) tracked as the next feature.
updateSource: backlog triage of open GitHub issues

required.title: Atomic feedback-store writes + dup-send warning (#7)
required.summary: Store.save() writes temp+fsync+rename (no mid-write corruption); a post-send MarkSent failure warns loudly.

required.title: Clean attacker-influenced egress identity strings at the source (#9)
required.summary: App/path/ancestry run through model.Clean when built, so a crafted argv can't carry ANSI/RTLO into storage or the terminal.

required.title: Liveness dimension (active/armed/dormant) fed into scoring (#23)
required.summary: Three-state liveness (active ▸ / armed ◐ / dormant †) derived once in interpret against the live-process set, stored on Assessment.Liveness, and read by BOTH scoring (a dormant remnant caps at Monitor unless a tripwire fires) and display (mark.Classify maps the value to a glyph). Killed the display-only DRY split; only ever lowers urgency, so no new false-positive surface. Decision recorded (dec-liveness-scoring).

required.title: Findings concern-coloring + revisitable decision flags (#4)
required.summary: Assessment.Concern (trust×location×behavior → minimal→elevated) colors the Monitor-tier rows so the ~300 Apple rows recede and non-Apple/unsigned ones stand out; opt-in concern sort under `s`. New local internal/ack store records a revisitable 'reviewed / leave it' decision — flagged (☑), never hidden, re-flagged '⟳ reviewed · changed' when the finding's fingerprint changes; `a` toggles. Separate from the shareable feedback labels; wired via Actor.Ack/Unack so the TUI keeps its model-only decoupling.

stretch.title: Real destination names (SNI/DNS) in the tree (#3)
stretch.summary: Passive SNI capture / DNS-query correlation to show destination hostnames instead of IPs; the inspector already parses SNI.

workstreams.name: Open-issue backlog
workstreams.summary: Worked the open GitHub issues one after another after v0.5.2: atomic feedback-store writes (#7) and Clean egress identity (#9) merged, then the liveness dimension (#23) and Findings concern-coloring + revisitable ack flags (#4). All required scope complete — v0.5.3 is ready to cut (develop→main→tag). SNI/DNS names (#3) remains as stretch/next.
